landing.howTitle: From customer idea to a file for printing.
landing.howBody: Keep the creative part simple: choose a template, tune the look, and export a model your home printer workflow can use.

name.title: Name it
name.detail: Start with a name, short label or friendly phrase. The editor keeps the input focused on printable proportions.

shape.title: Shape it
shape.detail: Pick a keychain, articulated name, nameplate or plant label, then tune font, style and dimensions.

export.title: Export it
export.detail: Download a local file, inspect it in your slicer and prepare it for the printer and material you use.

landing.productsTitle: Four templates for the names people ask for.

keychain.title: Name keychain
keychain.body: A familiar tag with a keyring hole and a raised name.

articulated.title: Articulated name
articulated.body: Linked letters for a flexible, playful keyring.

nameplate.title: Nameplate
nameplate.body: A compact plaque for desks, drawers and makers' shelves.

plantLabel.title: Plant label
plantLabel.body: A pointed label for pots, herbs and small garden rows.

landing.runTitle: Print one today. Build a repeatable workflow tomorrow.
landing.runBody: Use the local browser generator for one-off gifts, shop samples and repeatable home-business work. Self-host the same workflow when you want your own address; a hosted workspace is only planned.

browser.title: Use it in your browser
items: Geometry and exports stay on this device

selfHost.title: Self-host the static app
items: Serve the built files from your own infrastructure
Keep the same local browser workflow
Read the Docker and static setup in the README

landing.localFirstTitle: Your design work stays close to you.
landing.localFirstBody: In the default browser and self-hosted workflows, fonts, geometry generation and exports run locally. Open Keychain is MIT-licensed open source.
landing.betaTitle: A generated file is not a physical-print guarantee.
landing.betaBody: Check every export in your slicer and test it on your own printer. Printer, material and settings can all change the result.
